title: Dimensionless stable linear autonomous flow and unit-disk invariance fixture
purpose: Define a transparent exact flow and constraint set for teaching dynamics and a trivial viability kernel without making infrastructure resilience claims.

mathematical_structure.state_space: R^2 with closed unit disk K for initial-state membership

maps.name: entrance_time
maps.definition: For ||x0||>1 return log(||x0||); else return None

assumptions.statement: Autonomous flow dx/dtau=-x; no control, uncertainty or disturbance.
All states, times and constraint radii are dimensionless.
A state is viable only if the all-future constraint holds from tau=0, including initial admissibility.

invariants.statement: For all x0 in K, ||phi_tau(x0)|| <= 1 for tau >= 0.
For x0 outside K, boundary entrance time is log(||x0||), not initial viability.

numerical.representation: Python math binary64 and separate JavaScript binary64 reference; SVG path is sampled explanatory geometry
numerical.precision: IEEE-754 binary64 for numeric references; no GPU comparison

limitations: The admissible unit disk and flow are illustrative, with no empirical physical domain.
The viability kernel equality pertains only to the declared autonomous system.
A state outside K that later enters K does not satisfy initial viability.
